name: oli-integration-server
description: Universal integration server for OliOps, OliCommerce, OliFlow, OliExplore, Oli-Locator, and OliSalesTrack. Bridges inbound/outbound webhooks, OAuth2, and GoHighLevel sync for Zapier, Make.com, n8n, and GHL. Zero external dependencies - runs on Node.js 18+ built-ins only.
